dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: #Well, now, if it isn't you, {NICKNAME}? What do you say? Ready to hone your fighting spirit here in the Great Training Arena of the Springs?

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: The Spiritdoors you activated haven't been fixed, sure, but this place is more than enough to serve as a surfing training ground!

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Come, enjoy surfing freely in these waters!
